integrity: The primary source was inspected at the general graph-measure structure theorem, Theorem 3.1, and the family characterization. The probability normalization follows from the source's exact weight identities. The conditional mean, variance, third centered moment, raw-moment recurrence, and fiber Cauchy transform were independently derived algebraically from the source support and weight formulas. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The probability-kernel normal form is specific to the bidegree-(m,2) extremal family generated by a nonconstant one-variable real rational Herglotz--Nevanlinna function. The global representing measure is generally infinite, although each fiber is a probability law. The statement does not provide a new general extremality criterion.
title: Unit-variance disintegration of a two-variable extremal Nevanlinna family
